Suggestions for staff briefings
This article is for people travelling soon
Traveling with Companion Animals on Aurelia Skyways

Aurelia Skyways aims to make each journey with a companion animal calm and orderly. The Companion Animal Travel Desk provides guidance before departure, helps with required documents, and confirms the arrangements that support a safe trip for both the traveler and the animal.

Please prepare all paperwork in advance and keep it easy to present at the airport. Staff will review health and travel documents, crate details, and any special handling notes. Clear and respectful communication helps avoid delay and gives the traveler confidence at every stage.

At the skyport, the animal should remain secured in the approved carrier until staff give further instruction. The carrier must be well ventilated, clean, and large enough for the animal to stand and turn comfortably. If the traveler is carrying food, bedding, or medication, these items should be packed so they can be accessed without disturbing the animal.

When a traveler mentions a concern, staff should respond promptly and with care. If the animal needs extra attention because of age, stress, or recovery from treatment, the Companion Animal Travel Desk can explain the available options and direct the traveler to the correct point of contact. <<FACT F012>> Place the animal case note with the journey file so the next team member can continue smoothly.

If the itinerary includes a transfer or a quarantine step, the same careful preparation applies. Travelers should follow the instructions given by the Companion Animal Travel Desk and keep all documents with them. <<FACT F028>> If anything changes before departure, the traveler should inform staff as soon as possible so the record remains current.

For the smoothest experience, please arrive prepared, listen closely to staff guidance, and keep the animal calm throughout the process. For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.
